page.overview:
Who is Oliver Grayson I?

Mark Grayson (grandson) Oliver Grayson II (adopted grandson) Unnamed † (co-grandparent) Unnamed † (co-grandparent)

Oliver Grayson I is an unseen character mentioned in Invincible. He is the late father of Debbie Grayson and the maternal grandfather of Mark Grayson, also known as Invincible.

Debbie later honored his memory by naming her adopted son, Oliver Grayson, after him.

Oliver Grayson I does not appear in the series, and most details about his appearance remain unknown. However, it is implied that he had a natural human skin tone, similar to his daughter Debbie. In his later years, he was known to have white hair.
